column1: # The original scan had a bug treating literal SQL NULL as "has English text" (unquoting
# NULL with no surrounding quotes returns the string "NULL", which isn't '', so it passed
# the has-text filter). Of the original 566 entries, 561 were false positives -- their
# English CompletionText is genuinely NULL, nothing to translate, not a real gap at all.
# Only these 5 have real English text. Still blocked on the same Wowhead-doesn't-expose-this-
# field issue documented in STATUS.md, but the true scope is 5, not 566/571.

column3: A thousand years has passed and just as it was fated, one stands before me. One who shall lead their people to a new age.$B$BThe Old God trembles, $N.
